items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations, actively exploited in the wild since September 4, 2026.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Authentication Bypass)
items.summary: An authentication bypass flaw in Adobe Commerce that allows high-privileged authenticated attackers to circumvent security controls and gain unauthorized write access to protected resources.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources and hijack customer accounts.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update addresses critical and important vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security-Feature Bypass) in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security-Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security-Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Privilege Escalation)
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type (RCE)
items.summary: A remote code execution vulnerability in Adobe Commerce caused by insufficient validation of uploaded file types, allowing attackers to upload and execute malicious scripts.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension for Magento allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Customer Account Takeover via REST API (SessionReaper)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce where an attacker could take over customer accounts through the Commerce REST API, with active exploitation observed.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Authentication Bypass)
items.summary: An authorization bypass flaw in Adobe Commerce that allows low-privileged authenticated attackers to bypass a security feature and read select data without user interaction.
